definitions.explanation: The standard layout or template for writing documents, letters, or forms. Refers to both the structure of the document and blank forms to be filled in.

examples.japanese: {書式|しょしき}に{従|したが}って{記入|きにゅう}してください。
examples.english: Please fill it in according to the format.

examples.japanese: {申請|しんせい}{書|しょ}の{書式|しょしき}はウェブサイトからダウンロードできる。
examples.english: The application form format can be downloaded from the website.

examples.japanese: レポートの{書式|しょしき}が{決|き}まっているので、{必|かなら}ずそれに{合|あ}わせて{書|か}いてください。
examples.english: The report format is fixed, so please be sure to follow it when writing.

notes:
USAGE:
{書式|しょしき} is used in business, academic, and administrative contexts to refer to the prescribed layout or template of documents. In computing, it can also refer to file format or text formatting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {書式|しょしき}に{従|したが}う (to follow the format)
- {書式|しょしき}を{整|ととの}える (to format properly)
- {書式|しょしき}{設定|せってい} (format settings, in software)
